XCAPITOLO.Corpo:

• System: Bodywork

  • Device: Windscreen/headlight washer fluid reservoir

  • Fault: "Check-Control" warning due to lack of headlight washer fluid with the washer fluid reservoir full

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: The windscreen/headlight washer fluid reservoir contains concentrated detergent and/or distilled water

• Action: Dissolve one tablet of glass cleaner (product code no. 83122298202) in 0.5 litres of water and add it to the liquid already present in the windscreen/headlight washer fluid reservoir.

    If the problem persists, check the condition of the reservoir and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In the vehicle in question, the windscreen/headlight washer fluid level is measured by the flow of current in the reservoir. However, concentrated detergents and distilled water are not conductive, preventing the system from detecting the level correctly.
